description: Initialization code for Atmel SAML MCU series, configuring clock generators, oscillators, and power management for the SAM L21 microcontroller.

methods.name: gclk_reset
methods.description: Resets the generic clock controller and sets default clock source.

methods.name: osc32k_init
methods.description: Initializes the 32kHz oscillator if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: xosc32k_init
methods.description: Initializes the external 32kHz crystal oscillator if enabled.

methods.name: osc16m_init
methods.description: Initializes the 16MHz internal oscillator if enabled.

methods.name: dfll48m_init
methods.description: Configures the DFLL48M for 48MHz clock generation.

methods.name: flash_waitstates_init
methods.description: Sets flash wait states for 48MHz operation.

methods.name: gclk_main_configure
methods.description: Configures main GCLK to use DFLL48M.

methods.name: gclk_usb_configure
methods.description: Configures USB clock generator if enabled.

methods.name: gclk_adc_configure
methods.description: Configures ADC clock generator if enabled.

methods.name: pause_for_debug
methods.description: Provides a delay for debugging purposes if enabled.
